name: Yume mo Sugara Hana Arashi
source:
A whimsical, award-winning point-and-click visual novel adventure game from the creators of HUNGRY TEA PARTY and My Dear Frankenstein.

Relax into a dreamscape alongside a friendly, hungry demon called Baku.
Explore a world made of fairytales, traditional Japanese legends, classic Western literature, and peculiar scenery where real-life physics doesn't apply.
Solve riddles and puzzles to help colorful characters, some human, some not.
But be warned... the further you go into your dream, the less you may want to wake up.
translation:
由《HUNGRY TEA PARTY》与《My Dear Frankenstein》的创作者带来的获奖作品，一场异想天开的点击式视觉小说冒险。

与友好又贪吃、名叫“貘”的妖怪一起，在梦境中放松身心。
探索由童话、日本传统传说、西方经典文学，以及不受现实物理法则束缚的奇景构成的世界。
解开谜语与机关，帮助各具特色的角色，有些是人类，有些则不是。
不过请小心……在梦中走得越深，你或许就越不愿醒来。
